title: Recoverable Depreciation on LandlordGuard Claims — Basis Questions and Answers
content:
These answers set out when depreciation withheld from a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy replacement-cost payment is released or forfeited.

**When is withheld depreciation released?**
Only when proof of completed repair is received no later than the depreciation recovery period that starts on the date of the initial actual-cash-value payment. The period is counted in calendar days from the date of that payment, running for the tier's depreciation recovery days, and proof received on the last day is on time. The payment date is the date recorded on the claim's initial actual-cash-value payment.

**How much is released?**
The smaller of the remaining holdback and the documented incurred cost (capped at the replacement-cost amount) less the actual cash value, never below 0.00. The actual cash value is the replacement-cost amount less the depreciation.

**What happens to holdback left when the period ends?**
It is forfeited in one entry.

**Worked release (hypothetical figures).** Replacement-cost amount 12,000.00 USD, depreciation 3,000.00 USD (so actual cash value 9,000.00 USD), holdback 3,000.00 USD.

| Documented incurred cost | Capped at replacement cost | Less actual cash value | Release (smaller of that and the holdback, not below 0.00) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 13,500.00 | 12,000.00 | 3,000.00 | 3,000.00 |
| 10,500.00 | 10,500.00 | 1,500.00 | 1,500.00 |
| 8,800.00 | 8,800.00 | negative | 0.00 |

**Is proof on the last day on time? (hypothetical dates, 180-day period)**

| Initial actual-cash-value payment | Last day of the period | Proof received 30 June | Proof received 1 July |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 January of a non-leap year | 30 June | on time | too late |
